Default is "true": caching is enabled.
Disable this only for debugging and development.
items.translation: 默认为"true"：启用缓存。仅在调试和开发时禁用此选项。

items.source: Set the prefix that gets prepended to view names when building a URL.
items.translation: 设置构建 URL 时附加到视图名称的前缀。

items.source: Set the suffix that gets appended to view names when building a URL.
items.translation: 设置构建 URL 时附加到视图名称的后缀。

items.source: Set the view class that should be used to create views.
items.translation: 设置用于创建视图的视图类。

items.source:
Set static attributes to be added to the model of every request for all
views resolved by this view resolver. This allows for setting any kind of
attribute values, for example bean references.
items.translation: 为通过此视图解析器解析的所有视图的请求模型添加静态属性。这允许设置任何类型的属性值，例如 Bean 引用。

items.source:
Specify the maximum number of entries for the view cache.
Default is 1024.
items.translation: 指定视图缓存的最大条目数。默认值为 1024。

items.source:
Set the view names (or name patterns) that can be handled by this view
resolver.
items.translation: 设置此视图解析器可以处理的视图名称（或名称模式）。

items.source:
Set the view names (or name patterns) that can be handled by this view
resolver. View names can contain simple wildcards such that 'my*', '*Report'
and '*Repo*' will all match the view name 'myReport'.
items.translation: 设置此视图解析器可处理的视图名称（或名称模式）。视图名称可以包含简单通配符，例如 'my*'、'*Report' 和 '*Repo*' 都将匹配视图名称 'myReport'。
